title: Κοάλα καθεύδει
learning_goal: Practice Koine Greek location prepositions (under, on, beside, in, in front of, through/out of, toward, onto) with clear articles in simple present third-person sentences.  There is only one preposition per sentence and no verbs take a direct object.  Each frame contains two sentences (with different subjects and verbs; the preposition is different in both sentences but always has the same 'complement'.
plot: Panda, Dinosaur, and Glaux notice Koala sleeping in many strange places.

frames.text_koine: Δεινόσαυρος καταβαίνει ἀπὸ τῆς κλίνης. Κοάλα καθεύδει ἐπὶ τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: Dinosaur comes down from the bed. Koala sleeps on the bed.

frames.text_koine: Γλαύξ πίνει ἐπὶ τῇ τραπέζῃ. Κοάλα καθεύδει ὑπὸ τὴν τράπεζαν.
frames.text_english: Glaux drinks on the table. Koala sleeps under the table.
objects: A low round wooden table in warm brown with smooth edges and three stout legs.
A small clay cup half-filled with clear water.
positioning: Glaux perches at the near edge of the table on the right.
Koala sleeps tucked under the table near its left leg.
The low round wooden table in warm brown with smooth edges and three stout legs remains centered in the scene.
The small clay cup half-filled with clear water rests on the table near Glaux.

frames.text_koine: Δεινόσαυρος ἐσθίει παρὰ τὴν τράπεζαν. Κοάλα καθεύδει ὑπὸ τὴν τράπεζαν.
frames.text_english: Dinosaur eats beside the table. Koala sleeps under the table.
objects: A low round wooden table in warm brown with smooth edges and three stout legs.
A round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust.
positioning: Dinosaur kneels beside the table on the left side.
Koala still sleeps under the table near the back.
The low round wooden table in warm brown with smooth edges and three stout legs sits in the middle.
The round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust sits on the table near the front edge.

frames.text_koine: Πάνδα προσέρχεται πρὸς τὴν κιβωτόν. Κοάλα καθεύδει ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ.
frames.text_english: Panda comes toward the chest. Koala sleeps in the chest.
objects: A medium lidded wooden chest with bronze hinges and a dark walnut finish.
positioning: Panda tiptoes toward the chest from the left.
Koala sleeps curled inside the open chest on the right.
The medium lidded wooden chest with bronze hinges and a dark walnut finish stands open on the right side of the room.

frames.text_koine: Δεινόσαυρος ἀναβαίνει ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην. Κοάλα καθεύδει παρὰ τὴν κλίνην.
frames.text_english: Dinosaur goes up onto the bed. Koala sleeps beside the bed.
objects: A small wooden bed with a muted forest-green blanket and a cream pillow.
positioning: Dinosaur climbs up onto the foot of the bed from the left.
Koala sleeps on the right side beside the bed.
A small wooden bed with a muted forest-green blanket and a cream pillow rests along the back wall.

frames.text_koine: Γλαύξ μένει παρὰ τὴν θυρίδα. Κοάλα καθεύδει ὑπὸ τὴν θυρίδα.
frames.text_english: Glaux stays beside the window. Koala sleeps under the window.
objects: A small square window with a wooden frame and open shutters.
A thick blue-covered book with a simple white border.
positioning: Glaux stands beside the window on the left, holding the book at her side.
Koala sleeps curled directly under the window on the right.
The small square window with a wooden frame and open shutters is set in the back wall.
The thick blue-covered book with a simple white border is held in Glaux's wings.

frames.text_koine: Πάνδα ἐκβαίνει ἐκ τῆς θύρας. Κοάλα καθεύδει πρὸ τῆς θύρας.
frames.text_english: Panda goes out of the door. Koala sleeps in front of the door.
objects: A sturdy wooden door with a bronze ring handle and vertical planks.
positioning: Panda steps out through the door from inside to the stoop.
Koala sleeps curled just in front of the door.
The sturdy wooden door with a bronze ring handle and vertical planks opens outward at the center of the cottage wall.

frames.text_koine: Δεινόσαυρος τρέχει πρὸς τὸν λίθον. Κοάλα καθεύδει ἐπὶ τῷ λίθῳ.
frames.text_english: Dinosaur runs toward the stone. Koala sleeps on the stone.
objects: A smooth oval gray stone with a flat top.
positioning: Dinosaur runs along the path from the left toward the stone.
Koala sleeps stretched out on top of the stone.
A smooth oval gray stone with a flat top sits beside the path in the foreground.

frames.text_koine: Γλαύξ παίζει παρὰ τὸν κύβον. Κοάλα καθεύδει παρὰ τὴν σφαῖραν.
frames.text_english: Glaux plays beside the block. Koala sleeps beside the ball.
objects: A painted wooden cube, bright green with smooth edges.
positioning: Glaux stands at the left midground playing beside the cube.
Koala sleeps curled beside the ball on the right.
The small red-and-white striped ball rests near Koala.
The painted wooden cube, bright green with smooth edges, sits just behind the ball.

frames.text_koine: Πάνδα μένει παρὰ τὴν τράπεζαν. Κοάλα καθεύδει ἐν τῷ σάκκῳ.
frames.text_english: Panda stays beside the table. Koala sleeps in the bag.
objects: A soft tan cloth bag with a drawstring and gentle folds.
A low stone table with a smooth marble top and sturdy legs.
positioning: Panda stands beside the table on the left.
Koala sleeps curled inside the bag on the table.
The soft tan cloth bag with a drawstring and gentle folds sits on the table.
A low stone table with a smooth marble top and sturdy legs sits in the background.

frames.text_koine: Πάνδα μένει εἰς τὴν κλίνην. Κοάλα καθεύδει ἐπὶ τῇ κλίνῃ.
frames.text_english: Panda stays at the bed. Koala sleeps on the bed.
objects: A soft tan cloth bag with a drawstring and gentle folds.
A small wooden bed with a muted forest-green blanket and a cream pillow.
positioning: Panda stands at the foot of the bed.
Koala sleeps peacefully on the blanket, having emerged from the bag.
The soft tan cloth bag with a drawstring and gentle folds lies on the bed.
A small wooden bed with a muted forest-green blanket and a cream pillow fills the background.
